name: Weapon Triangle
title: Weapon Triangle
text: Physical weapons possess a unique hierachy.{br}<icon>Swords</><red>Swords</> best <icon>Brutes</><green>Gauntlets</>.{br}<icon>Brutes</><green>Gauntlets</> best <icon>Spears</><blue>Spears</>.{br}<icon>Spears</><blue>Spears</> best <icon>Swords</><red>Swords</>.{br}<icon>Firearms</><orange>Guns</> are not affected by the Weapon Triangle.

name: Composure
title: Composure
text:
Each playable unit has a Composure gauge that decreases everytime unit defeat an enemy, and reset at the end of each chapter.
The unit falls into <red>Anguish</> if Composure reaches 0.{br}When in <red>Anguish</>, unit is uncontrollable and will indiscriminately attack everyone, even allies.{br}

name: Dual Wield
title: Dual Wield
text:
All units can choose to equip a second weapon as offhand weapon, at the cost of Attack Speed, as both weapon's weights contribute towards the calculation.
This allows unit to make follow-up attack with offhand weapon after the attack with main weapon. Unit can also counterattack with offhand weapon, if enemy is out of main weapon's range, but within offhand weapon's range.

name: Undead
title: Undead
text: <yellow>Negator:</> Andy{br}<yellow>Type:</> Self-targeting Compulsory-activation{br}<yellow>Detail:</> Negates any and everything that puts him near death. He still has a sense of pain.

name: Unluck
title: Unluck
text: <yellow>Negator:</> Fuuko Izumo{br}<yellow>Type:</> External-targeting Compulsory-activation{br}<yellow>Detail:</> Brings an unlucky event to any target that directly touches her bare skin. The scale of the event is determined by likability.

name: Untruth
title: Untruth
text:
<yellow>Negator:</> Shen Xiang{br}<yellow>Type:</> External-targeting Compulsory-activation{br}<yellow>Detail:</> Once he looks at his target, it forces the target to reverse their thoughts and actions.
<yellow>Detail:</> Shen's often seen winking because blinking with both eyes cuts off the distribution of his ability, so he makes it a habit to only close one eye at a time.
